div.head: V Atr 8
div.ab: And ealle mæssepreostas we biddað ⁊ lærað, þæt hy beorgan heom sylfum wið Godes yrre.
⁊ ealle mæssepreostas we biddað ⁊ læreiþ, þæt hy beorgan heom sylfum wið Godes yrre.
And ealle mæssepreostas we biddað ⁊ lærað þæt hi beorgan heom silfum wið Godes irre.
And ealle mæssepreostas we biddað and lærað þæt hy beorgan heom sylfum wið Godes yrre.
And we pray and admonish all priests to guard against incurring the wrath of God.
And we require and instruct all priests to protect themselves against the wrath of God.
And we pray and instruct all mass-priests to protect themselves from God’s anger.
Und alle Priester bitten wir und weisen wir an, dass sie sich selbst vor Gottes Zorne hüten.
And we ask and instruct all priests to guard themselves against God's anger.
